completeness.debug: MATCH (n:`mushroombody_Neuron`) WHERE (n.status = "Traced" OR n.status = "Roughly traced" OR n.status = "Prelim Roughly traced" OR n.status = "final" OR n.status = "final (irrelevant)" OR n.status = "Finalized" OR n.status = "Leaves") WITH apoc.convert.fromJsonMap(n.roiInfo) AS roiInfo WITH roiInfo AS roiInfo, keys(roiInfo) AS roiList UNWIND roiList AS roiName WITH roiName AS roiName, sum(roiInfo[roiName].pre) AS pre, sum(roiInfo[roiName].post) AS post MATCH (meta:`mushroombody_Meta`) WITH apoc.convert.fromJsonMap(meta.roiInfo) AS globInfo, roiName AS roiName, pre AS pre, post AS post RETURN roiName AS roi, pre AS roipre, post AS roipost, globInfo[roiName].pre AS totalpre, globInfo[roiName].post AS totalpost ORDER BY roiName
